title: Ann Connor — a tour of the Historical Room, sides A and B
subtitle: Bethel Presbyterian Church, Historical Room — oral history
date_source: No date is stated anywhere on either side: there is no slate, no cassette label read aloud, and no year spoken. The content dates itself only approximately: she speaks of the congregation's 225th anniversary as an event being planned (the church dates from McMillan's meeting of 5 November 1776, so 1776 + 225 = 2001) and of a skit at the Miller Homestead on 'the 22nd of July'. The archive's own transcript header records 'recorded c. 2001'. Day and month cannot be established from the material, so the date is recorded as unknown with a terminus of c. 2001. 2026-10-18, in the source folder name, is the digitisation date, not the recording date.

provenance.collection: Bethel Presbyterian Church — Historical Room oral histories
provenance.capture_notes: Three renderings of Side A and two of Side B are held: the ALAC masters (46:13.248 and 46:41.749), MP3 access copies of both, and — for Side A only — the earlier, much quieter original capture (AAC mono, 46:01.792) with a gain-raised FLAC and a 192 kbps MP3 made from it. Only the ALAC masters are transcribed; see README §2 for the measured relationship between the Side A files.

speakers.label: ANN
speakers.name: Ann Connor
speakers.note: Retired history teacher; built the Historical Room in the former study of Rev. Murray C. Reiter. The first name is spoken on the tape by another voice at about 8:50; the surname is never spoken and comes from the archive's filename.

speakers.label: INTERVIEWER
speakers.name: unidentified interviewer
speakers.note: An off-mic questioner (possibly more than one) who prompts the tour; the tape never names them and the archive's transcript does not either.

speakers.label: OTHER
speakers.name: voices in the room
speakers.note: Occasional third voices — someone arriving, an aside about a car — not separable or identifiable.
